header: Everything a shift plan touches, in one system
lead: Rotas, hours, absence and payroll live in one place. Branch managers and head office always see the same week.

items.title: Rota building
items.text: Drag a shift into place. Contract hours, rest periods and the branch budget are checked straight away.

items.title: Reliable clock-in
items.text: Staff clock in on the branch tablet or on their phone near the branch. Every later correction is logged.

items.title: Absence in one list
items.text: Holiday, sick leave and unpaid days arrive in one approval list, with the staffing gap shown next to each.

items.title: Costs before you publish
items.text: Every draft week shows its wage cost against the branch budget, so overspending is a decision, not a surprise.

items.title: Payroll in one file
items.text: At month end you get a file in the format your payroll provider accepts, with approved corrections included.

items.title: All branches on one screen
items.text: Area managers compare all their branches and move a shift between two of them without a phone call.
